timingBasis: Controller receipt of accepted nonempty events, relative to audio origin; excludes setup/load and pixel rendering; audio origin is not a click timestamp.
submitBasis: MT submitted timestamp is unavailable unless an explicit submit/submitted event exists; requestStarted is separately reported.
inferenceBasis: inferenceMs is inference wall duration. started.previewIntervalMs samples the configured interval at inference start; completed.previewIntervalMs is the updated interval for subsequent previews. Both ratios are separate and are not observed audio-arrival cadence or dropped-frame measurements. Snapshot-end lag also includes input delivery, scheduling and waiting.

semanticReview.scope: Qualitative four-point review of this one public sample; no translation accuracy percentage.
semanticReview.result: All six final translations preserve all four core meanings; base run 2 has a wording variant. This review does not score preview quality.

accuracyScope: WER scores the final source of one 22-word sample; repetitions are not independent accuracy samples and 0 WER is not general accuracy.
stableSourceBasis: First accepted source receipt with stableSourceChars > 0, relative to audio origin. It may first occur on a revisable preview prefix or on a final source; firstStableSourceReceipt.isFinal distinguishes them. Lengths are UTF16 code units, not tokens. This is not a final-source or pixel-render timestamp; numeric receipt events preserve prefix lengths and revisions.
modelPreparationBasis: The most recent successful model preparation, recorded before benchmark audio: verificationMs is _verifySelectedModel/verifyModel; nativeLoadMs surrounds whisper.load; warmupMs surrounds one synthetic one-second silent inference plus status notification overhead and does not enter source/MT events. totalMs has its own stopwatch sample. A ready resident model can reuse the prior preparation record; this map alone does not establish a fresh load per session. Entry modelLoadMs surrounds controller.loadModel including preparation and settings persistence; it is not pure Metal initialization. Session setupMs/preparationMs have separate start clocks and may include system authorization waits.
preparationOutlierPolicy: All observed setup, preparation and model loading values are retained in per-run records, medians and min/max; no authorization wait is removed or reassigned to audio latency.
previewIntervalBasis: Configured 500 ms initial preview interval; actual started/completed interval values and every completed inference are retained. Configured interval is not a promise of a subtitle every 500 ms. MT previews have a separate 1500 ms throttle; source growth does not imply one MT request per preview.

baselinePlus6.scope: Three runs per model on the same public fixture; separate runs and changed implementation. Differences describe observed results and do not isolate the cause of a speed change. +6 did not record stable-prefix receipt or preparation phase splits; missing is not zero. Baseline preparation outliers remain in its ranges.

runProtocol.scope: Six separate fresh-process benchmark runs actually load and warm once each. GPU compilation cache was previously used. This does not measure first-install cold start or the GUI click timestamp.

preparationSystemWaits.scope: User-resolved system Keychain authorization was observed before audio. The recorded setup/preparation durations include that wait; the Keychain call itself has no separate duration clock. Model loading remains a separate measure; no outlier is removed.

measurementScope.scope: One public clean 11-second English-to-Chinese sample, repeated three times per model; final WER and four-point semantic review do not establish general or preview accuracy.
